Veṃ_Tālītamā_Bhaṭṭa
one of the authors of Nṛsiṃhasarvasva, RASB.

Vendāntimahādeva
alias Mahādeva Vedāntin alias ºSarasvatī alias Mahādeva Tīrtha, disciple of Svayaṃprakāśa or Prakāśānanda Sarasvatī.
See under Mahādeva Vedāntin.

Veṃtālitamā_Bhaṭṭa
one of the authors in the Nṛsīmhasarvasva, RASB.

Venapaṇḍita
-C. on Puṣkaraprādurbhāva. SB. New D..

Venapaṇḍita
alias Cennu Bhaṭṭa alias Canna, son of Viṣṇu Bhaṭṭopādhyāya of Andhra.
-C. Prakāśikā on Tarkabhāṣā of Keśava Miśra. See under the text.

Venasūkta
Av. See R. N. Dandekar, Venasūkta in the Atharvaveda, D.. Mirashi, Fel. Vol. p.. 24-30.

Vennāditya
son of Rudrāditya, q. by Yāca in his Yācaprabandha,
